meta.title: Kitchen Remodel Roadmap
meta.eyebrow: Home project · Galley kitchen → open plan
meta.summary: Open the galley kitchen to the dining room and replace cabinets, counters and appliances, keeping a working sink for as many weeks as possible.
meta.nextAction: Ridgeline submits the permit drawings by Nov 6, then places the cabinet order.
meta.footer: Example data that ships with the project-roadmap skill.

phases.title: Plan and budget
phases.purpose: Agree what changes and what it can cost before anyone draws plans.
phases.doneWhen: A signed scope and a budget with a 10% contingency.

phases.title: Design and permits
phases.purpose: Turn the scope into drawings the city will approve and the builder can price exactly.
phases.doneWhen: Permit issued and every finish chosen.

phases.title: Demolition and structure
phases.purpose: Open the wall and get the structure signed off before anything new goes in.
phases.doneWhen: Beam in and framing inspection passed.

phases.title: Plumbing, electrical and HVAC rough-in
phases.purpose: Run everything inside the walls once, and pass inspection before drywall closes it up.

phases.title: Cabinets, counters and finishes
phases.purpose: Install everything you see and use every day.

phases.title: Final inspection and punch list
phases.purpose: Get the final sign-off and fix the small things while the crew is still around.

steps.label: Agree the scope: wall out, island in, sink stays put
Get three bids and choose a builder
Finalize the layout and cabinet design
steps.result: Layout v3 approved; the island seats three.

steps.label: Choose counters, tile and appliances
steps.result: Quartz counters and an induction range.

steps.label: Submit drawings for the building permit
Set up a temporary kitchen in the dining room
Remove the wall and the old cabinets
Install the beam and pass the framing inspection
Run plumbing and power to the island

gates.text: Keep the old range hood, or vent through the roof?
gates.resolution: Decided Oct 29: vent through the roof, which adds $900.

gates.text: The building permit has to be issued before demolition starts.
Cabinets take 8 weeks; ordering after Nov 14 pushes finishes into April.

activity.text: Scope signed: wall out, island in.
D1 decided: vent through the roof.
Finishes chosen: quartz counters, induction range.
